note: The tail sits 22 funnel steps + 5 plan boards deep and no route reaches it directly, so every entry here drives `/welcome` with `.vicifull/drives/tail-walk.js` and names its board in `window.__T`. `"seedScript": ".vicifull/tail-session-seed.js"` signs a mock user in BEFORE the first paint — without it /welcome opens with no account and the first step draws no name field — which is what lets `scripts/vicifull/audit.mjs` run these unattended through shot.mjs. By hand, `node .vicifull/vtail-cap.mjs "/welcome" out.png --sig=… --do='window.__T="<board id>"' --script=.vicifull/drives/tail-walk.js --wait=2400` does the same (it is funnel-cap.mjs with a tolerant goto; plain networkidle times out at 30s when several agents are capturing). tail-walk.js is a STATE MACHINE, not a script: each tick reads the page, matches a string only one board draws, does that board's whole action, and stops on __T's own headline. It was a fixed list of taps in pass 1 and that raced twice — first on a flat 420ms per tap, then on a Metro rebuild reloading the page mid-walk and dropping it back to an early funnel board. At ~55-70s this is the longest drive in the run and the most exposed to a hot reload; the state machine simply answers whatever board it lands on. It answers age 24, 'A few times a week', and BOTH 'Late at night' and 'When I’m home alone' — the second is what keeps 18 and 19 from being skipped (D077). Budget 70-90s per capture.

Watch for a capture taken while Metro is rebuilding: it catches Expo's fast-refresh overlay — a 42x42 dark rounded box with a lightning bolt at 8,802 — which adds three signature rows and takes mean |Δ| from 0.97 to 1.72. It is a capture artefact, not the app. Check the sig for a row at `8 | 802 | 42 | 42` and re-shoot.
the frame's 'About 6,100 days' needs age 24 and nine dark days in COST_30, which is what the walk answers
the chart's `today · day 41` is the frame's own literal, passed as day={41} from welcome.tsx — not account data, so no seed affects it

note: `.vicifull/vtail-px.mjs d a [x,y …]` mean/max |Δ| over the whole body y54…830 with NO region excluded, plus an 8x16 block map and point samples. `.vicifull/f-tail-grid.mjs d a` a 10x10-device-pixel patch average over the corner-bloom band (y 58…130), which is the only way to see a 5/255 wash error through 0.12 grain. `.vicifull/f-tail-band.mjs d a x0 y0 x1 y1` pixel count over a threshold in one region, with a histogram. `.vicifull/f-tail-zoom.mjs d a x0 y0 x1 y1 z` a side-by-side magnified crop — the thing that settles whether a numeric residue is a defect or antialiasing. `.vicifull/f-tail-col.mjs d a x y0 y1` the darkness centroid down one column, for asking where a stroke actually sits. `.vicifull/f-tail-rowavg.mjs`, `.vicifull/f-tail-spec.mjs` (re-cut a spec's Transcription from this drop), `.vicifull/f-tail-cmp.mjs` (re-cut its Comparison from two sigs).
